reporting-org.narrative: Norad - Norwegian Agency for Development Cooperation

description.narrative:
Overall Objective: Contribute to Improve community support for gender equality in Iraq.
Outcome: 2300 community members are supporting enhanced women participation in the public spaces.
Output 1.1: 2000 community members are aware of the importance of women's rights & participation in the public sphere. Output 1.2: 80 women have sustainable access to share their experiences in safe spaces.
Training Activities: • IAA will conduct a 3-day training in Sulaymaniyah for 20 activists on women's rights, peaceful communication, and equality. • Organize a camp for 30 activists, including 20 newly trained and 10 from previous phases, focusing on campaigning strategies and social activism techniques.
Campaigns and Initiatives: • Support 10 women's rights initiatives led by previously trained activists using resources from earlier project phases. • Conduct an awareness campaign across five governorates on the needs and rights of Persons with Disabilities (PWD), particularly Women with Disabilities (WWD), to promote inclusivity and raise awareness of their challenges.
Safe Spaces for Women: • Enable 80 women to access sustainable, safe spaces to share experiences. • Hold a meeting in Baghdad for 18 previously trained women to refresh their knowledge, discuss challenges, and strategize future initiatives. • Conduct four sessions for 20 women per session to provide safe spaces for women to share experiences and engage in supportive discussions.
Position Paper: • Draft a position paper consolidating themes of women's needs for safe spaces, serving as a resource for advocacy and policy recommendations to improve access to such spaces in target areas.
